rental app that allows user to locate and rent a power bank and keep it for as long as they like
without being attached to a wall socket.

power bank station manufacturing, power bank rental app development, payment gateway integration,
and management system development. Feel confident to contact us if you’re interested in the shared
power bank rental business.

## Business Model

[Business Model]

### **What is a power bank sharing business and how to start it?**

A power bank sharing business involves deploying charging stations where users can rent portable
power banks, charge their devices on the go, and return them to any nearby station. It’s an ideal
solution for those who forget their charger, prefer not to buy one, or need a quick battery boost
without interrupting their day.

Compared to capital-intensive sharing economy models like car or scooter rentals, power bank sharing
offers a low-barrier entry with high scalability, making it a promising business opportunity.

**To start a power bank sharing business, you need these five things:**
* Power Bank Stations
* Power Banks
* Operation Backend System
* Power Bank Sharing Mobile App / Web App (optional)
* Card Reader / POS Terminal (optional)

[**Learn more**][24]
[**Contact us**][25]

# We Give Power
# To The People!

ChargeBar ® has been providing businesses and the public with convenient and secure mobile device
charging solutions since 2009. ChargeBar ® offers a wide range of scalable mobile device charging
products that will fit your requirements and budgets. We offer both free use and pay-per-use
charging stations. Products include both secure lockers and power bank rental stations. We also
offer high top charging tables, charging benches, outdoor solar powered stations and compact desktop
units. We also produce custom charging and asset management solutions for your company's many
rechargeable devices. Laptop charging lockers are also available.


[VIEW PRODUCTS][18] [ABOUT US][19]
[header-img]

## Why You Need A ChargeBar®

Today, more than ever, your customers require power to charge their mobile devices. People will hang
around longer if they can shop knowing that they do not have to run back to their car or office to
recharge their phones. Visitors to conferences and conventions will come directly to the booth or
display offering free charging. It’s a fact!

[icon]

##### [Safety][20]

Your customers can now charge their devices quickly and securely inside one of our lockable charging
stations. Users also do not have to worry their personal information will be downloaded from the
phone.

[icon]

##### [Available as Free Use or Vending Machines][21]

Many businesses prefer to offer this service as a free-use convenience. However, you can purchase
our stations with several POS options such as the Nayax wireless payment service. Now you can accept
all forms of credit card and other contactless payments.

[icon]

##### [Customization Available][22]

ChargeBar® offers solutions to match your particular needs and location. We offer stay and charge,
lock and charge and walk and charge solutions. Vinyl branding and various cable options are
available.

[icon]

##### [Warranty][23]

All ChargeBars ® are covered by a 2-year warranty against defect. Just let us know and we will fix
it. We have technicians available throughout the United States and Canada.

## About Us

In a world where people rely on their phone for all their business and social needs, the need to
provide on-demand mobile battery charging has become more essential and not optional. ChargeBar® was
started to be there when your customers need it the most! Help remove the fear of “Disconnect
Anxiety”, yes, it’s a thing, from your customers’ minds so they can shop or enjoy your conference,
convention, festival or outing and no longer fear they will be unreachable.

[Learn More][24]

## Our Products

ChargeBar® offers many different battery charging options. Take a look at what we have and let us
know if there’s something we don’t have so we can get it for you.

## Purchasing or Leasing

We have a ChargeBar® that will fit your budget. We offer competitive and volume pricing on all
units. If you prefer not to purchase, we offer leasing as an alternative to a large capital
expenditure.
[Financing Available - Apply Now][25]

##### BENEFITS OF LEASING:
* Avoid large capital expenditures
* Costs are 100% deductible
* Flexibility to upgrade to newer units at lease end;

 

##### ADDITIONAL BENEFITS:
* Provide patrons with a necessary service
* Draw in customers and keep them longer
* Pre-empt “disconnect anxiety”

 

[Learn More][26]

## Renting

In this day and age having a ChargeBar® at your event is a must in kind to having refreshments and
washrooms. All of our rental units are plug-and-play ready to go out of the box.

##### SHOW ORGANIZERS:
* Enhance sponsorships
* Generate revenue from exhibitors
* Capture market research
* Provide patrons with a necessary service

 

##### EXHIBITORS:
* Attract visitors to your booth
* With 10 minute charge times visitors will stay longer
* The longer visitors stay in your booth, the more time you have to communicate

 

[Learn More][27]

## Frequently Asked Questions

If you cannot find the answer to a question please feel free to [contact us][28].

#### [Can I add a POS system so I can charge customers?][29]

Yes, all of the lockers and power bank rental stations can be ordered with pre-installed POS units
so you can generate revenue with each charge.

#### [What types of phones can be charged?][30]

All of our ChargeBars® can charge all mobile phones and devices. Units include plugs for Apple,
Android, Blackberry and virtually any other make of phone.

#### [Are your units compatible with USB-C devices?][31]

Yes. Units come with USB-C and Lightning charging cables. All of the cables can be easily replaced
if they get worn out. They are locked in place so users cannot remove them.

#### [Is this safe for my phone?][32]

Yes. All charging stations include patented charging technology with circuitry to prevent
overcharging and damaging a phone battery. There is no risk to your phone.

#### [Are they compatible with tablets and iPads?][33]

Yes. If the plug fits the device it will charge it. Also, we have several locker models with doors
wide enough to fit tablets. We also have specific models that charge laptops. Please inquire for
more information.

#### [What happens when new types of charging cables are introduced?][34]

The design of the ChargeBars® allows the owner to quickly add the new cables.

#### [What setup is involved with the rental units?][35]

All of our free-standing charging units are plug-and-play ready. Just plug it in when it arrives and
it will do its thing without any further involvement.

#### [What happens if a user forgets their password?][36]

In the event a user cannot retrieve their phone, there is an override password that will allow you
to retrieve their phone. In the event of a power failure there is a mechanical release accessed from
the back.

## Frequently Asked Questions

#### [Can I add a POS system so I can charge customers?][29]

Yes, all of the lockers and power bank rental stations can be ordered with pre-installed POS units
so you can generate revenue with each charge.

#### [What types of phones can be charged?][30]

All of our ChargeBars® can charge all mobile phones and devices. Units include plugs for Apple,
Android, Blackberry and virtually any other make of phone.

#### [Are your units compatible with USB-C devices?][31]

Yes. Units come with USB-C and Lightning charging cables. All of the cables can be easily replaced
if they get worn out. They are locked in place so users cannot remove them.

#### [Is this safe for my phone?][32]

Yes. All charging stations include patented charging technology with circuitry to prevent
overcharging and damaging a phone battery. There is no risk to your phone.

#### [Are they compatible with tablets and iPads?][33]

Yes. If the plug fits the device it will charge it. Also, we have several locker models with doors
wide enough to fit tablets. We also have specific models that charge laptops. Please inquire for
more information.

#### [What happens when new types of charging cables are introduced?][34]

The design of the ChargeBars® allows the owner to quickly add the new cables.

#### [What setup is involved with the rental units?][35]

All of our free-standing charging units are plug-and-play ready. Just plug it in when it arrives and
it will do its thing without any further involvement.

the back.

one location and return it at another—ideal for public spaces like cafes, malls, and airports.

### What is the Power Bank Sharing Business?

Power bank sharing is a smart mobile charging solution where users can rent a portable power bank at
one location and return it at another—ideal for public spaces like cafes, malls, and airports.

It eliminates the need for fixed charging outlets and offers convenience for users on the go.

For operators, it's a high-margin, scalable business with growing demand across developing and
developed markets alike.

responsive websites, beautiful documents, on-brand graphics, and engaging social media content.
Start from scratch, import what you've got, or start with a template — and you'll have something
credible and ready in minutes, not hours.

used to train AI features by default. However, you can opt out at any time directly through your
account settings.

Proudly shaping British life for over 150 years, John Lewis & Partners blends timeless tradition
with contemporary living. Discover a unique blend of modern design and enduring quality for your
home and wardrobe. From beautifully curated fashion and homeware that expresses your individuality,
to the latest technology and beauty favourites, every piece is chosen with care by our Partners.
This is our promise to you, and it is anchored by our commitment to [never be knowingly
undersold][65] on quality, service, and price.

### Never Knowingly Undersold

It’s more than just the price promise of hundreds of top brands matched against 25 leading
retailers. It’s the quality you expect – think homeware designed to stand the test of time, and a
minimum 2-year guarantee on all electricals as standard. And it’s the service you can rely on,
including Click & Collect from over 16,000 locations, free, easy returns and payment plans.

**Company Introduction**

Litashared is a global full-chain service provider for power bank rentals, specializing in shared
power banks. We are mainly engaged in the research and development, production, sales, and operation
of shared chargers, providing ODM/OEM services as well as hardware and software solutions for power
bank rental stations.

Based in China and serving the global market,Litashared supports more than 300 shared power bank
brands worldwide. Our products are sold in over 158 countries, including the United States, the
United Kingdom, France, Norway, Poland, Australia, Canada, South Korea, Singapore, Vietnam, and
other regions, and are well received by customers.

Our company boasts aprofessional R&D team specializing in loThardware and software, with proven
experienceserving industry leaders like Alibaba and Meituan.

market operations capabilities

## Why Choose Power-2Go Products

Power-2Go builds rugged, high-performance, off-grid lighting solutions engineered for when failure
isn't an option. We focus on the total cost of failure - delivering long-haul reliability,
field-tested durability and service that works as hard as you do.


Our versatile range of high-performance LED lighting solutions are designed to withstand the
toughest conditions. Our lighting towers and portable work lights are meticulously engineered to
deliver reliable and highly efficient illumination wherever you need it most. From the busy
construction site to emergency situations, our solutions are built to perform no matter the
environment.

[Power-2Go TL-400 Led Tower on site]

### Deployment Speed

Deploy the units in seconds, designed for maximum portability, perfect for a single-person to
operate and set up where larger towers wouldn’t be suitable. 

[Power-2Go Twin Battery Compartment on the TL300 Tower Light]

### Battery Powered

Battery Life lasts days on lower modes and up to 8 hours on most turbo settings. Will keep you
fully  illuminated with seamless battery switching capability.

[Power-2Go TL-500 Battery operated light on site]

### Noise & Fume Free

Silent with no fumes or pollutions , ideal for tight spaces with no windows , rescues where loud
generators aren’t an option.
